policy: Original source routine/data first. Shared source-engine translation replaces one-off recreation; unresolved semantics fail closed.

DCS_LOGO.note: Original object/timing path translated; original ADD_PIXEL_ROT/ADD_PIXEL_VEL plotter effects remain missing.

show_sports_logo.note: Original 17 WIMP logo pieces, source timing and MOVE_BACK_OFF_SCREEN process scheduling translated; packed SPORTBKBMOD records are now ingested generically, artwork/palette block renderer still partial.

show_gameplay.note: WRESTLE.ASM::start_match's PSTATUS==0 (#0plyr) path now runs from the real attract flow: the RNDRNG0(7)-skip-7 index1 draw, LIFEBAR.ASM::init_life_data (LIFE_MAX=163), and #0plyr's PLYRNUM/PSIDE wrestler-actor creation are translated (wm/match.h), and the SLEEP 3*60 + wait_on_butn 10*TSEC timing is exact. Whichever actor draws WM_ROSTER_BRET runs the real wm_arcade_move_bret control layer every tick with a real visual backend (wm/bret_backend.h) and real movement (wm/movement.h): convert_facing, set_velocities, execute_walk's dispatch, and change_walk_anim's leg-cycle reselection (all 12 hrt_walkM_fF_anim sequences) are all translated, so a Bret actor with real input genuinely walks with the correct animation. Its idle stance and 6 light/power punch/kick animations resolve to real wm_visual_sequence data, and each of those 6 now fires ANIM.ASM's real ATTACK_ON/ATTACK_ON_Z/ATTACK_OFF (wm_arcade_ani_attack_on(_z/_off), real since fix38) at the exact frame index hand-traced from each attack's own HRTSEQ2.ASM source, setting real attack_mode/attack_xoff/.../WM_MODE_CHECKHIT. Not translated: wm_arcade_check_wrestler_collisions is still not called from wm_match, and even if it were, victim hurt boxes (wm_arcade_set_hurt_box) need per-frame ANI3 hit-box data (SYS.EQU IANI3X/Y/Z/ID) baked into the WIMP image assets themselves, not the animation script -- a third asset format this port has not parsed -- so no attack can actually land yet. Also not translated: change_walk_anim's TORSO half and set_rotate_anim/change_anim1 (idle-turn animation; real FACING_DIR tracking needs an as-yet-unlocated shared 'compute NEW_FACING_DIR' routine, substituted with MOVE_DIR while moving), INIT_LADDER_TABLE/CURRENT_LADDER/NUM_OPPS multi-drone team selection (one placeholder opponent only), and DRONE.ASM's wnshort_t/wnmed_t/wnlong_t script data and blkbase_t/blkatk_t/sklhhdly_t/sklhrdly_t skill tables (SKLM macro expansion not in the checked-in source tree, so not guessed) -- meaning a CPU-controlled wrestler never actually throws a button/stick input.

show_title.note: Original setup/button timing translated; cycle_lava runs as a source PID on the shared scheduler. NTITLESC executes the original BIGWWF.BDD CI8 blocks and RGB555 palettes through the verbatim NTITLESCBMOD placement/depth/transparent records. The original 69-frame SPARKLE.IMG WIMP artwork is generated and the source FLASH_PID/ATTRACT_ANIMPID create/kill lifetime is translated. The checked-in WWF tree only references external SPRINKLE_GLINTS, RANDOM_SPARKLE and WHERE_WRESTLMANIA_SPARKLES; current sparkle placement/cadence is explicitly provisional until that shared helper/table source is recovered. Lava palette substitution remains.

show_bios_tips.note: Original bio tips routine not translated.

show_operatormsg.note: Original operator message routine not translated.

attract_mode_scheduler.note: Active source JSRP order, AMODE_LOOPS branch structure, and initial SLEEPK 8 blank are translated on the original 53 Hz source clock.

wimp_ci8_renderer.note: CI8/TLUT pixels/hotspots translated for converted assets; general object/process semantics incomplete.

two_channel_wrestler_composite.note: set_image attachment offset math translated for Bret bring-up.

start_match.note: Two of start_match's three creation paths are translated in wm/match.h: PSTATUS==0 (#0plyr, attract-mode, driven from WM_ATTRACT_SHOW_GAMEPLAY) via wm_match_start_attract, and PSTATUS!=0 single-human (#1plyr) via wm_match_start_selected, now reachable for real from WM_APP_MODE_MATCH_INIT after select/pregame (app.c's previous dead-end stub). The #1plyr path uses whatever the select screen actually chose (wm_pregame_state::player_source_wrestler, i.e. SELECT.ASM's real scramble_table mapping, not a random draw) and a real human control layer: wm/human_input.h maps the platform's wm_input_state onto the same but_val_cur/stick_val_cur fields DRONE.ASM's commit path writes, so a human playing Bret gets real wm_arcade_move_bret dispatch, real execute_walk movement (wm/movement.h), and the visual backend (wm/bret_backend.h) driven by genuine button/stick input rather than an always-idle drone. #2plyr (two humans) is not translated. Neither path creates a real opponent team: CURRENT_LADDER/NUM_OPPS is unported, so both fall back to one placeholder-drawn opponent. CLOSE_PROGRESS_SCREEN, ring/rope/crowd/timer process creation, and collision/pin/finisher lifecycle are all still unported for both paths -- see the show_gameplay note above for exactly what wrestler control/animation coverage exists today (Bret only).

credit_start_select.note: SELECT.ASM source tables are regenerated in CI; cursor grid/BMOD placement/scramble_table roster mapping/player start-mug-sound data/attributes, exact four-way cursor legality, START+UP random-select gate, random wander/home movement, source select_clock PSTATUS reset/OLD_PSTATUS behavior, 15-second timer and 30-tick final wait constant are translated. Credit/buy-in process wiring, original objects/text/mug art and full select process orchestration remain.

combat.note: Portable demo AI/health/contact logic is test scaffolding and is not part of normal arcade execution.

audio.note: Original game-side DCS command semantics/backend not translated.

background_blimp_bdd.note: Paired BDB/BDD BLIMP data is decoded as raw source blocks plus palettes and cross-validated against compiled BMOD records; NTITLESC is wired block-for-block with no WIMP crop or flattened recreation.

source_clock.note: DISPLAY.EQU TSEC=53 is executed independently of 60 Hz N64 presentation using an accumulator; literal 60-tick source sleeps remain literal.

source_process_scheduler.note: Cooperative CREATE/sleep/kill-by-PID execution is shared by translated attract processes; full MPROC semantics and process pdata remain to port.

bmod_packed_records.note: BAKGND.ASM 64-bit block records decode exactly and CI extracts NTITLESCBMOD/SPORTBKBMOD verbatim from BGNDTBL.ASM. NTITLESC now consumes header index, palette, Z and MAP_FLAGS transparency at render time; the reusable renderer still needs extending to remaining backgrounds.

typed_animation_stream.note: Mixed WORD/LONG source stream supports frame refs, REPEAT, SETMODE, velocity LONG operands/modes, PAUSE, SETSPEED, zero velocities, facing/xflip and END. Unknown commands stop explicitly.

source_dependency_ir.note: CI scans every SUBR/SUBRP and static CALL/JSRP/CREATE edge and emits dependency frontiers for attract_mode and start_match without inventing unresolved dynamic semantics.

animation_source_ir.note: CI scans typed WORD/LONG animation data and W/L packing macros across the original ASM tree, preserving source expressions and unresolved forms without inventing pointer or command semantics.
